parole.significato: to start (up); to set into motion; to put into action
parole.testo: Ultimately from Proto-Slavic *porinǫti. Compare Aromanian purnescu, purnire.
Unknown. Likely from Proto-Slavic *posmuriti, probably influenced by Hungarian szomorú (“sad”). Compare Russian пасмурный (pasmurnyj, “overcast, gloomy”).

parole.significato: fast (a period of abstaining from or eating very little food), fasting
parole.testo: Derived from Proto-Slavic *postъ.
Borrowed from Proto-Slavic *rygati.

parole.testo: From some South Slavic language (probably Bulgarian) *сварогъ (*svarog), ultimately from Proto-Slavic *Sъvarogъ.
From sineală + -iu. Ultimately borrowed from Proto-Slavic *siňь.
From Proto-Slavic *sъlъ, compare Slovene sel.
